title: An open popup is not placed again when its pane resizes
body:
decade places an xdg popup when it opens and on `reposition_request` (`place_popup` in `src/server/compositor.rs`, from 803bdf7), keeping it inside the parent pane's client area. When the pane resizes while the popup is open, decade does not place it again, so a menu can hang past the pane's new edge or over a neighbour until it closes.

Jack chose to leave this until it causes trouble.

## Proposal

When a pane's client area changes, decade places each open popup of its toplevel again and sends a configure.
